text: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.

This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will make your way prosperous and successful.
All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting, and training in righteousness, so that the servant of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.
For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.
Blessed is the one who does not walk in step with the wicked... but whose delight is in the law of the LORD, and who meditates on His law day and night.
I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God endures forever.
So then, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
Be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.
The unfolding of Your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, teaching and admonishing one another in all wisdom.
Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words became a delight to me and the joy of my heart.
The law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
